name: Cat-Cow Spinal Mobility

instructions.description: Begin on hands and knees in a comfortable neutral position.
Gently round the upper and lower back while exhaling.
Reverse the movement into a mild arch while inhaling.
Continue slowly without forcing the neck.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variations.variationDescription: Cat-Cow Spinal Mobility — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Move gently and keep the neck comfortable.
